machine: Motorola moto g57 power, Qualcomm SM6435 (Snapdragon 6s Gen 4 class), 8 CPU cores, Adreno 7xx GPU, 7.3 GB, Android 17
cpu: The same Kotlin kernels on Android ART (dalvikvm -Xmx1g) via KernelinCpu (median of 5 runs after 2 warmups). Run with scripts/bench-android-cpu.sh
gpu: WebGPU in Chrome 155 for Android, vendor qualcomm, architecture adreno-7xx. Run with scripts/bench-android.sh
notes: gpuKernelMs = data already on GPU, average of 20 back-to-back dispatches, median of 5. gpuEndToEndMs = upload inputs + run + read results back, median of 5. matchPct compares the GPU output with the Kotlin CPU output.
